name: WIF World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Dark Ninja held it in spring 1996 (a former champion by that October, outside this wing's own served window); a rookie, Barbwire, holds it by June 1997 before Lancaster Bomber wins it from him in "a classic encounter."

name: WIF Internet Championship
epitaph: Dark Ninja won it from Tony "Falcon" Silver in spring 1996 (outside this wing's own served window); Roundhouse holds it by June 1997 before losing a title-implicated match to Falcon via outside interference.

name: WIF Hardcore Championship
epitaph: Tony "Falcon" Silver holds it through mid-1997, defending it against the dethroned former World Champion Barbwire in a no-DQ, no-time-limit match whose loser must say "I respect you" to the winner.

name: WIF Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The High Fliers (Superfly Dan & Eagle Andy) held it in 1996, outside this wing's own served window. Search & Destroy hold it by mid-1997, billing themselves as four-time champions in their own open challenge.
